multisession.screen.title: Sessions
multisession.session.label: %s · %s
multisession.world.parked: Open in a background session — Play switches to it
multisession.disconnect.transfer: Transfer to another server is not supported in background
multisession.quick.none: No pinned servers yet. Pin one with ☆ on the Sessions tab, in the server list or on the By address tab.
multisession.address.label: Server address
multisession.option.warpAnimation.toolti: Warp jump effect when switching between sessions in a world. Off: sessions switch instantly.
multisession.option.disconnectToasts.too: Show a notification when a background session gets disconnected.
multisession.option.confirmClose.tooltip: Ask before a session is disconnected with ✕.
multisession.option.newSession.tooltip:
Yes: the current session moves to the background and the server opens in a new one.
No: the current session disconnects and the server opens in its place.
multisession.option.titleButton.tooltip: Always: show the Sessions button in the main menu even without open sessions, for quick join, joining by address and settings. With sessions: only while sessions are open.
multisession.close.title: Close session %s?
multisession.close.message: The session will disconnect. A singleplayer world is saved before it closes.
multisession.option.hideAddresses.toolti: Hide server IP addresses in the Sessions window, notifications, the address field and the vanilla server list. Handy for streaming.
multisession.toast.world_closed.reason: Only one singleplayer world can be open at a time
multisession.screen.new_world.replaces: The open singleplayer world will be saved and closed: only one world can be open at a time.
